literature_notes: The ledger contains two lines, both from PMC7987976. L1 reports a FLAG/streptavidin tag inserted at the C-terminus of mouse Lrrn4cl (prior to the stop codon), i.e. after residue 238. Per the authoritative topology landmarks, residues 219–238 are intracellular; the C-terminal tag therefore faces the cytoplasm and is not a surface tag site. L2 uses the identical LRRN4CL-FSA construct to confirm N-glycosylation via PNGase F shift; it introduces no new insertion site. No ledger line reports a tag at the extracellular N-terminus (after signal-peptide cleavage at residue 22) or anywhere in the extracellular span (23–197). The C-terminal insertion is recorded in other_positions. Zero extracellular sites is the correct answer.

literature_other_positions.note: FLAG+streptavidin tag inserted after the last coding residue (238) of mouse Lrrn4cl prior to the stop codon; residues 219–238 are intracellular per topology landmarks, so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the cell surface.
